name: nepal-tenders-scraper
title: Nepal Government Tenders Scraper (PPMO e-GP / Bolpatra)
description: Scrapes Nepal's official e-Government Procurement portal (bolpatra.gov.np, PPMO) for the latest tender notices, filtered search by keyword/category/method/entity, and full per-tender detail pages with bid schedule, fee, contact, and documents. No login needed to browse.
